AppSecret.description: Facebook application secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'AppSecretSecretName' in the 'FacebookSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

SdkJs.description: Optional URL override for the Facebook JavaScript SDK.

FBInit.description: Whether Orchard should emit the FB.init JavaScript bootstrap call.

FBInitParams.description: JSON object serialized as the arguments for FB.init.

Version.description: Facebook Graph API version to target, for example 'v20.0'.
